profileParagraphs: Joel is a senior fullstack developer and software architect with more than 14 years of experience building production systems across Java/Spring Boot backends and React/TypeScript frontends. He has strong experience in API design, data modeling, PostgreSQL, microservices, CI/CD, accessibility-aware development and pragmatic architecture for complex products.

He has worked across banking and payments, e-health, personal assistance, education, culture, public-sector services and startup environments. His assignments include scalable backend services, React-based web applications, interactive user interfaces, integrations, cloud-hosted platforms, operational troubleshooting and systems with high requirements for quality, traceability, uptime and performance.

Joel combines analytical problem solving with hands-on implementation and team collaboration. He contributes with system design, robust code, code review, debugging, mentoring, Scrum Master support and AI-assisted development practices that improve maintainability and development flow.
